Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted “share the same nationality” by treating dual nationality as mutually exclusive. After identifying Samantha Jo (Samantha Win) as Canadian American and Kreesha Turner as Canadian, it incorrectly concluded they do not share a nationality, overlooking that both are Canadian. This reflects an oversimplified, binary handling of dual nationality and incomplete synthesis of the gathered information.
